{{Quote|The demands of the dark side can ravage the flesh, but fortunately it is possible to balance the scales by siphoning life from another to bolster your own.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], ''[[Book of Sith]]''|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Body''' was one of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] three schools, or focuses, of combat using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], specifically the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. The [[Force power/Legends|powers]] of Body drew from the [[Living Force/Legends|living Force]] of the user's own cells and affected another being's. Its techniques included [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]], [[convection]], [[cryokinesis]], [[Force drain/Legends|drain life]], and death field.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
